tasks.title: full_status: whole, provisional, unknown or not declared, from the ledger alone
tasks.description: full_status(rows, phase, git_root, full_commands, run=None) in _evidence_io.py returns {answer, basis, runId}. NOT_DECLARED when full_commands (the resolved meta.fullGate) is empty; UNKNOWN when the phase has no mergedHead; otherwise walk scope full rows newest first, keeping only WHOLE-BEARING ones: status passed; not a repeat (no verdictSource); observations.ranTotal > 0 with a countsBasis; every step carrying durationMs; observations.dirtyOutside present and empty (the paths dirty outside recorded_paths before the first command, which the runner task writes); the steps' published commands equal to full_commands verbatim and in order (the published rule _record_run applies). For each, ask _worktrees.merged_into(git_root, mergedHead, row.testedState.head, run=run) (a SHA is a ref to git; run is that module's injectable seam): CONTAINED -> WHOLE with the runId; NOT_CONTAINED -> keep looking; UNKNOWN -> remember it and keep looking. None contains: any UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN with git's sentence; else PROVISIONAL, whose basis names the newest shape-valid run and that its head does not contain mergedHead, or, when no row is whole-bearing, the nearest disqualified row and why: 'FULL RUN ON A DIRTY TREE: certifies nothing about <head>' (dg7), 'the full run counted nothing' (dg8), 'FULL RUN RAN k OF n DECLARED ENTRIES' (dg9). The ledger is the only source: no manifest pointer is consulted (dg14). DO NOT add a full arm to latest_by_subject: its docstring keys it for a pointer write and its readers treat every key as a pointer subject - reconcile writes a PHASE pointer for any non-task scope, _doctor_completions.check_evidence_pointers would report every full row as 'record ahead of the plan', and gen-demo-manifest._stamp_pointers stamps from it. A full row carries no phaseId, so it is already skipped there; a case pins that it stays skipped. _same_subject gains a head arm comparing testedState.head, so reusable_run matches a full row only on the same head (dg16: a green phase-scope row never satisfies full scope, widen-only pin). Red-first with a real git fixture: dg6 (mutation: compare head == mergedHead -> red on a head that contains it without being it); dg7; dg8 (mutation: drop the ranTotal check -> red); dg9 (mutation: compare lengths -> red on the same length with a different command); dg14; a git answer of 128 -> UNKNOWN (mutation: fold it into provisional -> red); NOT_DECLARED without fullGate; reconcile over a ledger holding a full row moves and refuses nothing (mutation: add the arm to latest_by_subject -> red).
